exit.name: ARM assembly Linux exit example
exit.body:
@ GNU assembler, ARM Linux
.syntax unified
.text
.global _start
_start:
    mov r0, #0
    mov r7, #1
    svc #0

cortex-m3-startup.name: Cortex-M3 startup (GNU syntax)
cortex-m3-startup.body:
@ Cortex-M3 GNU/Clang startup. Adapt memory map and add device IRQ vectors.
.syntax unified
.cpu cortex-m3
.thumb
.section .isr_vector,"a",%progbits
.balign 128
.word __stack_top
.word Reset_Handler
.rept 14
.word Default_Handler
.endr
.section .text.Reset_Handler,"ax",%progbits
.thumb_func
.global Reset_Handler
Reset_Handler:
    cpsid i
    ldr r0, =__data_load
    ldr r1, =__data_start
    ldr r2, =__data_end
1:  cmp r1, r2
    bhs 2f
    ldr r3, [r0], #4
    str r3, [r1], #4
    b 1b
2:  ldr r1, =__bss_start
    ldr r2, =__bss_end
    movs r3, #0
3:  cmp r1, r2
    bhs 4f
    str r3, [r1], #4
    b 3b
4:  bl kernel_main
.thumb_func
Default_Handler:
    cpsid i
5:  wfi
    b 5b
